'''To'onalk''' was where a hideous hag-witch lived, according to [[Sullustan/Legends|sullustan]] [[Holojournalist/Legends|holojournalist]] [[Den Dhur]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated that To'onalk was excluded from the ''Atlas'' and subsequent system appendixes due to it being an imaginary place.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_5.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-10-23}}</ref>
